story_text:
## What is haloflo?
Haloflo is an innovative hair dryer attachment designed to target the entire hairline simultaneously, letting you sit back and relax while your lace dries. Originally designed in January 2026, this beauty tool modernizes hair accessories by offering a happy medium between concentrated nozzle attachments and overhead dryers. It gently directs airflow along the hairline and comes in a variety of sizes to ensure inclusivity for every user that wants to find their glo with haloflo.
## Whats the goal of this campaign?
The goal of this campaign is to 3D print and produce the first Haloflo collection while also securing the intellectual property for haloflo and building the foundation of trevava as a beauty tech company. As a woman who loves experimenting with different looks, I always found it frustrating to manually move a blow dryer from ear to ear during the wig install process.
## The Original Lace frontal attachment
## ( December 2025)
The creator designed the first version of the Lace Frontal attachment in December of 2025.
She aimed to create a timeless hair dryer attachment capable of dispersing air from ear to ear with the option of the entire wig install process being hands free.
## Design Problems: Too heavy
The initial prototype had some airflow but was entirely too big for practical use and too heavy to have an enjoyable used experience.
## Design changes:
## Hair dryer holder design, haloflo diameters & end knobs, universal sleeve.
To give a more reliable hold, the universal sleeve design changed by adding a ribbed texture to the inside. To simplify the design even further, the end knobs were removed. The ends still come in different lengths but they are no longer able to be changed. In addition, 2 diameter sizes were added to the attachment to accommodate for more head sizes.
## Introducing the newest version of the frontal attachment: haloflo™
## (May 2026)
The frontal attachment design has evolved into its final stage prototype. With the initial purpose staying the same, the design has developed to accommodate a wide range of head sizes and blow dryer types while being downsized to lighter weight.

## Haloflo Sizes
## Whats the heat resistance?
Haloflo™ is manufactured using materials rated for temperatures up to 150°C (302°F). Do not expose the product to temperatures exceeding this limit. Actual temperature exposure may vary depending on the blow dryer, heat setting, airflow, duration of use, and other conditions.
## How to find your size?
Haloflo™ is designed around the natural curve of your hairline. To choose the best size, measure the width of your hairline from one side to the other, following the points where the haloflo™ will sit above.
How to measure:
- Using a soft measuring tape, measure from one side of your hairline to the other.
- Keep the tape following the natural curve of your hairline rather than pulling it tightly across your forehead.
- Compare your measurement with the sizes below.
If your measurement falls between two sizes, we recommend choosing the larger size for a more comfortable fit.

## About the designer
Kayla Stevens is a Raleigh,NC native currently attending North Carolina A & T as a civil engineering undergraduate student. Growing up, aside from painting and expressing herself with fashion, she also took STEM classes (reluctantly). This is where her grandmother Corinne comes in, as she helped with practicing math and pushed Kayla to excel in subjects she ran from. An artist and woman of style herself, she also taught Kayla how to paint and loved wearing wigs. Trevava is named in honor of her memory.
